adversarialReview.planFigureUnderTest: The planner's brief states the SmartCity PDF path is html2canvas raster wrapped by jsPDF, failing 1.1.1 and 1.4.5 as well as 504.2.2.
adversarialReview.howItWasTested: Located every application-level jsPDF constructor and .save() call site in the served bundle and read the shared drawing helpers, rather than counting library tokens.
adversarialReview.result: FALSIFIED on the raster claim. Every application PDF path draws vector text via jsPDF .text() and jspdf-autotable. html2canvas is bundled but has zero call sites: `.html(` occurs 0 times in 5,578,225 bytes, and all six addImage( sites are inside html2canvas, the jsPDF html plugin, and canvg.
adversarialReview.resultThatSurvives: 504.2.2 still fails. The bundle contains 0 occurrences of the literals /StructTreeRoot and /MarkInfo, and jsPDF's own putCatalog writes only /Type /Pages /OpenAction /PageLayout, so tagged output is not reachable by configuration.
adversarialReview.secondResult: Not reproduced under my counting rule. grep -oF case-sensitive over the whole bundle: jsPDF 143, jspdf 5, html2canvas 23, autoTable 10, pdf-lib 0. The disagreement is most likely a counting-rule difference on a single-line minified file, and it is not load-bearing: the substantive correction is the raster claim, not the token count.

scopeDecisions: In scope: smartcity-dashboards, smart-files, plan-review, the original SmartCity, and the two repos the site-plan question forces in (hauska-engine, hauska-map).

Out of scope with basis: legacy-design-tools lib/plan-review-pdf and artifacts/api-server pdf renderers. The deployed Plan Review the Dashboards shell mounts is the NEW plan-review repo, established by GET on plan-review-app-ten.vercel.app returning <title>Plan Review</title> with /sc-kit.css and /app.js. LDT's PDF family is a different lineage and no dispatched surface serves it.
Out of scope with basis: smartcity-os repository source. The served bundle is the customer-facing artifact and was measured directly; repo source would only restate it.
constraintsHonored: No code written, no PR opened, no repository modified.
Live Bastrop touched only by HTTP GET (index, bundle).
No generator run against any live surface.
Sibling clones P:/tmp/g94-* and P:/tmp/g95-dash untouched; own clones under P:/tmp/g96/.
All verification exit-bounded: one-shot curl, one-shot pypdf inspection, bounded greps.
openAtCp1: Whether pdf-dossier and pdf-flood-drainage artifacts can be measured rather than code-read (no such artifact on hand).
